_about: Fixed functional-group label set for task T2. Each label has a SMARTS that RDKit matches against the reference molecule to produce the gold answer. SMARTS are matched with the default (non-uniquified) RDKit semantics on a sanitized molecule. 'enabled' is decided by measured support: the prepare step counts positives/negatives over the frozen molecule pool and records them in dataset_manifest.json. A label with too few positives or too few negatives is set to enabled=false and reported as N/A rather than scored.

labels.name: aldehyde
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bearing exactly one H and one carbon substituent.

labels.name: ketone
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon with two carbon substituents and no H.

labels.name: ester
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to an O that bears no H and is bonded to a carbon.

labels.name: carboxylic_acid
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to an OH.

labels.name: amide
labels.definition: Carbonyl carbon bonded to a trivalent nitrogen.

labels.name: primary_amine
labels.definition: Trivalent aliphatic nitrogen with exactly two H, not an amide, not imine/nitrile.

labels.name: nitrile
labels.definition: Carbon triple-bonded to a monovalent nitrogen.

labels.name: alcohol
labels.definition: Hydroxyl O bonded to an sp3 carbon.

labels.name: phenol
labels.definition: Hydroxyl O bonded directly to an aromatic carbon.

labels.name: ether
labels.definition: Divalent O bonded to two carbons. Subsumes esters and phenols structurally; kept because it is a named group the paper-style prompt would ask about.
labels.why_disabled: Disabled at config level, not for lack of support (553 pool positives). Its SMARTS matches every ester and phenol, so a model scored on it would be credited twice for one structural feature and the label would carry no independent information. Kept in the candidate list so the decision is visible.

labels.name: alkyl_halide
labels.definition: Halogen bonded to an sp3 carbon.

labels.name: aryl_halide
labels.definition: Halogen bonded directly to an aromatic carbon.

labels.name: sulfonamide
labels.definition: Sulfonyl sulfur bonded to a trivalent nitrogen.
labels.why_disabled: Disabled at config level, not for lack of support (63 pool positives). Sulfonamide is the group the reference paper's own prompt set leans on; this project deliberately does not copy that group list wholesale, so it is held back as a candidate rather than adopted by default.

labels.name: nitro
labels.definition: Nitro group in either the pentavalent or charge-separated depiction.
